external_collaboration.evidence_quote: The University Library collaborates with San Diego Public Library on a number of programs, including an ongoing resource sharing initiative sponsored by the San Diego Circuit. In addition to annual collaboration with SDPL and KPBS on the One Book One San Diego program, the University Library provides access and instruction related to the Clara Breed Historical Books Collection, which was originally collected and curated by former SDPL Director Clara Breed (1909 – 1994).
